patterns.note: Prominent use of full-bleed, high-quality photography as background for content sections, often with text overlays, creating an immersive experience.
Content is consistently organized into responsive grid layouts, frequently using 2x2 or 3x2 arrangements for product categories and editorial features.
A high-contrast palette of stark white, light gray, and black is consistently punctuated by a vibrant, strong red for accents and calls to action.
The main navigation bar shrinks in height and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, maintaining persistent visibility.
The hero image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls down the page.
Section headings are consistently set in a bold, uppercase sans-serif typeface, creating a strong and clear visual hierarchy across the site.

technique_notes: The header implements a sticky behavior where it reduces its height and fixes to the top of the viewport after a short scroll distance, ensuring persistent navigation without obscuring content.
Large hero and content section background images are set to parallax, moving at a slower rate than the foreground content to create a sense of depth and visual interest.
Content is organized into responsive grid layouts, allowing large, aspirational photography to serve as interactive category links or feature showcases with minimal, high-contrast text overlays.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clear hierarchy with bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (approx. 2-3x body text) and clean, legible body text for product details and descriptions.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for most structural elements and images, with subtle rounding (e.g., 2-4px) applied to buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within image-heavy content blocks, while product grids maintain a tighter, consistent rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its powerful, full-bleed photography that acts as both background and primary content, creating an immersive, aspirational experience. This, combined with a clean, high-contrast palette and bold typography, gives it an editorial, magazine-like quality that elevates the product presentation beyond a typical e-commerce site.
